Retain the balance ₹5,000 and adjust it against next year’s LTC claim

questions.explanation_english: Refund the unutilized ₹5,000 immediately to avoid penal interest When the actual eligible claim for a Leave Travel Concession journey is less than the advance drawn, the employee must refund the unutilized balance amount immediately. नहीं, प्रतिपूर्ति सबसे छोटे सीधे मार्ग के माध्यम से देय किराए तक सीमित है
हाँ, यदि मुंबई में 24 घंटे से कम ठहरे

questions.question_english: An employee avails “Anywhere in India” LTC to visit Goa. Can they visit Mumbai on the way and claim the fare for a break journey?
options_english: Yes, they can claim separate fares for Delhi- Mumbai and Mumbai-Goa legs
No, restricted to direct through fare by the shortest route
Yes, provided they stay in Mumbai for less than 24 hours during transit
No, a break journey automatically cancels the entire LTC claim submitted
questions.explanation_english: No, restricted to direct through fare by the shortest route When an employee visits a destination under Anywhere in India Leave Travel Concession, reimbursement is strictly restricted to direct through fare by the shortest route. Additional travel fares incurred for breaking the journey or visiting intermediate cities like Mumbai en route are inadmissible for claim reimbursement.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: नहीं, प्रतिपूर्ति सबसे छोटे सीधे मार्ग के माध्यम से देय किराए तक सीमित है। Anywhere in India LTC में प्रतिपूर्ति सबसे छोटे सीधे मार्ग के through fare तक सीमित है; बीच में मुंबई घूमने का अतिरिक्त किराया शामिल नहीं किया जा सकता।

questions.question_hindi: LTC यात्रा के लिए अनुमानित किराए का अधिकतम कितना प्रतिशत अग्रिम लिया जा सकता है?
questions.question_english: What is the maximum percentage of estimated travel fare that may be drawn as an LTC advance?
questions.explanation_english: 90% A Government servant can draw an advance up to ninety percent of the estimated travel fare for a proposed Leave Travel Concession journey. The remaining ten percent along with final adjustments is settled after the completion of the journey upon submission of original travel tickets and the final adjustment claim bill.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: 90%। LTC यात्रा से पहले अनुमानित किराए के अधिकतम 90 प्रतिशत तक अग्रिम दिया जा सकता है। शेष राशि अंतिम बिल और वास्तविक यात्रा प्रमाण पर समायोजित होती है।
